 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 30.05.2025 [Physical Hearing/Hybrid Hearing (as per request)] CRL.M.A. 17498/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The petitioner seeks quashing of FIR for offences under Section 363/376/34 IPC and Section 4/17 POCSO Act.
It is stated on behalf of petitioner that petitioner no.1 has got married to the prosecutrix.
It is also submitted that the complainant de facto, who is father of the prosecutrix is not supporting this petition.
3. Notice be issued to respondent no.2, who is father of prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for respondent no.3 prosecutrix accepts notice.
Learned APP for State accepts notice.
5. Status Report be filed within four weeks.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 28/06/2025 at 00:52:52 6.

Keeping in mind the nature of allegations levelled in the FIR, an affidavit of the complainant de facto and of the prosecutrix be filed testifying as to whether allegations levelled therein are truthful.
For, in case the allegations are truthful, both sides shall address as to why the inherent powers be invoked to quash such heinous offence.
